requirements.text: A user-friendly interface for patients to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments
Patients must receive notifications and reminders about their appointments
Patients should be able to flag urgent symptoms when booking appointments
An online repeat prescription request process allowing patients to select medications
Patients must receive acknowledgments after submitting prescription requests
Patients should receive notifications when their prescriptions are ready
Secure access to test results only after clinician review
Test results must be presented in an easy-to-understand format with explanations
Patients should have the option to ask follow-up questions regarding their test results
All patient data must be securely stored and encrypted
System must comply with GDPR for customer data storage
The portal must integrate seamlessly with existing practice management software
The portal must be accessible for patients with low digital literacy
Ongoing training and support must be provided for reception staff
